body: Mac window hall9k-55 at 2026-09-26 12:59 EDT: v0.10.51 is cut on abdb08375 (PR #590, task 1629bc9d, hall9k#589: a node joined by invite no longer reads 'not joined yet' forever; the origin high-water guard no longer refuses the project's pre-switch-on team events, and every reader orders them by their own stamp). Release run 36257156970 green, FIVE assets confirmed. Update: h9k update --restart. Then the repair step for the ARM64 VM or any node already stuck on v0.10.50: after updating, run h9k project reconcile hall9k once on that node; the daemon's automatic re-ask never fires for a node whose reconcile already completed, so this one command is required. The third commit rebuilds project documents written before the per-field team stamps existed, so expect a projection rebuild on first start. Effort high is bound on the Mac (pid 2938).
